translations.answer: Currently not possible. The detailed minimal example in the thread corrected the initial understanding of the return value of `normalize_with_norm` and demonstrated that a fallback could generate non-orthogonal frames, with evidence of differences concentrated in pyramidal friction; however, the maintainers have merely re-opened the issue and stated that they will check, but the root cause or merge of the fix has not been confirmed. The comparison of frozen-state, contact frame, cone type, and `qacc_warmstart=0` should be used for reproduction, but the replacement of the author's proposed `math.orthogonals` with a general effective fix cannot be done.
translations.applicability: Only directly applicable to commit 6882095 and the original post's minimal plane-capsule frozen-state configuration; other versions and contact geometry require reproduction.
translations.credibility.rationale: The answer has not been closed or there are unresolved conflicts in the source conclusions.
translations.details.attempts.0: The author proposed using `math.orthogonals(n)[0]` under a small tolerance and reported that the selection was replaced, but no maintainers have reviewed or merged the patch.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: The frozen state of the same scenario, clearing the warmstart, and comparing the common-world Jacobian, contact frame, friction cone type, and constraint force with `qacc` should be done; do not only compare the contact point position.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: No formal fix is available for registration; this replacement should be treated as a pending experimental validation and should not be directly upgraded to production or used as a baseline for training.
translations.details.environments.0: Tracking fixed to MuJoCo commit 6882095; one plane, one free capsule, one explicit contact pair; CPU double and jitted MJX float64, same frozen state, fresh data, `qacc_warmstart=0`.
translations.details.limits.0: Data is from a minimal frozen-state example; not yet verified for all plane-capsule postures, cone types, and MuJoCo versions.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Issue re-opened by maintainers; no further conclusions from the thread at the time of data collection.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Whether the `b_norm < 0.5` fallback for MJX plane-capsule leads to non-orthogonal tangent basis vectors and amplifies CPU-MJX dynamics differences?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: If the Whole-Body Control (WBC) relies on friction direction or contact force thresholds, regression testing on the CPU/MJX contact frame and cone configuration should be performed in the target version.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The fallback was attributed to the reuse of `math.orthogonals` for axis selection, but no subsequent projection or normalization has been performed. The root cause has not been formally confirmed by the maintainers.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The fallback was triggered when `b_norm=0.4407495` was encountered. Given `n=[0.3, 0.4, 0.8660254]`, the selection was `b=[0, 1, 0]`, resulting in `n·b=0.4`.
translations.details.symptoms.1: The Jacobian for the common-world point differs by approximately $5.82 	imes 10^{-18}$, but the active contact tangents are different. There is a significant difference in force under pyramidal friction compared to `qacc`, with `condim=1` and isotropic elliptic consistent.
translations.source.locator: MuJoCo #2774 Detailed correction and sim-to-real experiment 5082490175; maintainers re-opened 5104526098
translations.source.title: The numerical difference in the tangential base of MJX plane-capsule fallback still needs verification by the maintainer
